title: Hospital Sagrada Familia
description: empresa-social-del-estado-hospital-sagrada-familia-1.micolombiadigital.gov.co Hospital Sagrada Familia is a name shared by several hospitals across Latin America and beyond, the main one being Hospital Sagrada Familia E.S.E., a municipal state owned clinic in Toro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia, founded in 1941 and covering 15,395 residents plus ten rural health posts. Run by manager Aida Luz Díaz Corrales, it offers 24/7 emergency care, hospitalization, childbirth, dental, laboratory, X-ray and rehab services, with around 221,000 services delivered in 2023, ten percent more than 2022. The famous namesake is the Hospital de la Sagrada Familia in Bethlehem, Palestine, a Maltese Order maternity hospital opened in 1885 that delivers over 60 percent of the Bethlehem district's babies. Other Sagrada Familia hospitals exist in Quetzaltenango and Salcajá, Guatemala, in São Paulo, Brazil, with 282 beds and 10 operating rooms, and in Cabudare, Venezuela, dating from 1919.
